newsitem.title: USA: United Tech's Sikorsky seeks more US orders.
newsitem.headline: United Tech's Sikorsky seeks more US orders.

text.p: United Technology Corp's Sikorsky Aircraft unit said on Thursday it hoped Congress would appropriate more funds for the Pentagon to purchase Blackhawk helicopters than the $246 million in President Clinton's proposed 1998 defense budget.
A spokesman for Sikorsky, a unit of United Technologies Corp., said Sikorsky was hoping for 36 Blackhawks, although Clinton proposed only 18.
"We are hopeful that money will be appropriated for more Black Hawks," Sikorsky spokesman Bill Tuttle told Reuters.
He had no comment on possible layoffs at Sikorsky if the number of Blackhawk orders is not increased.
